item.title: Tasktap 1.0.1 — Simpler workspaces
item.description:
• One compact sidebar row per workspace, with agent attention and result indicators.
  • Terminal, browser and split controls on each surface.
  • Closing or moving the final tab closes its surface; terminal processes keep running.
  • Tab actions by right-click or Shift+F10, with reliable pending launches and preview moves.

Existing tabs, notes and preferences are retained. Apple silicon, macOS 26+ and Python 3 for terminals. Community build, not Apple notarized.
